_note: Draft for the maintainer, in the shape of the Space's data/methodology.json entrants.entrants records (the lab's entrant_metadata.py is not public). Values are what this run loaded; the maintainer's own run on the RTX PRO 6000 is authoritative.
name: Jebadiah 27B v2.1 (T1e inference recipe)
served_params_detail: 25,624,600,064 language-model parameters plus the 1,271,398,400-parameter untied lm_head, loaded as Qwen3_5ForCausalLM. The 460,730,096 vision parameters and 424,699,392 multi-token-prediction parameters in the checkpoint are not loaded. The rank-16 LoRA has 116,727,808 parameters in 496 merged linear pairs and adds none at serve time. Counts were read from pinned safetensors headers.
readout: One forward pass per question with the request payload repeated once in the prompt, thinking off; fp32 candidate-label logits and the shipped v2.1 per-type temperatures. When the top answer's probability is below 0.7, a second pass reads the same question with the options in reverse order and the two distributions are averaged; the trigger is the model's own confidence, never correctness. No generation and no abstention.

declared_capacity.max_options_detail: the single-token label alphabet at the answer boundary of the Qwen3.8 tokenizer: A..Z, then the 562 two-letter uppercase strings that are one token there (AINode's own alphabet is 68 labels; wider questions use the published extended alphabet). The suite's widest question has 255 options, so no request is refused for width.

kind_detail: A rank-16 LoRA (116,727,808 trained parameters) merged into full bf16 weights; the repository ships the merged weights and no adapter files. Same checkpoint as the jebadiah-v2.1 row; only the inference recipe differs.
inference_settings: --engine jebadiah_engine:JebadiahEngine --option model=frontier-infra/jebadiah-27b-v2-1 --option revision=e38b48b82bcda8943d0958072c042c5867284838 --option prefix_cache=true --option max_batch=64 --option batch_tokens=32768 --option cuda_alloc_conf=expandable_segments:True --option repeat_payload=true --option reverse_avg_below=0.7
